summary: Inspect and manage Agent Hub agents and prompt previews.

help:
Usage: agents [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Agent management (Agent Hub)

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  list         List agents.
  get          Get one agent by slug.
  versions     Show compact agent version history.
  activity     Show recent agent sessions and request logs.
  create       Create an agent using the Agent Hub API.
  preview      Show the effective runtime prompt/context preview for an...
  update       Update an agent using the Agent Hub API.
  credentials  Authorized local lab enrollment, refresh, refs and trusted...
  hosts        Remote hosts: register, revoke, grant tools, and the...
help.list:
Usage: agents list [OPTIONS]

  List agents.

Options:
  --active-only / --all         [default: active-only]
  --coding-only / --non-coding
  --limit <int range>           [default: 100; 1<=x<=500]
  --offset <int range>          [default: 0; x>=0]
  --json                        Print full API payload.
  --scores                      Show compact assignment rows with all score
                                dimensions.
  --by-model                    Group active agents by primary model.
  --help                        Show this message and exit.
help.get:
Usage: agents get [OPTIONS] {slug}

  Get one agent by slug.

Arguments:
  slug  Agent slug  [required]

Options:
  --json  Print full API payload.
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.versions:
Usage: agents versions [OPTIONS] {slug}

  Show compact agent version history.

Arguments:
  slug  Agent slug  [required]

Options:
  --limit <int range>  [default: 20; 1<=x<=100]
  --json               Print full API payload.
  --help               Show this message and exit.
help.activity:
Usage: agents activity [OPTIONS] {slug}

  Show recent agent sessions and request logs.

Arguments:
  slug  Agent slug  [required]

Options:
  --external-id <str>  Filter by caller external/task id.
  --limit <int range>  [default: 10; 1<=x<=100]
  --json               Print full API payload.
  --help               Show this message and exit.
help.create:
Usage: agents create [OPTIONS] {slug} {name}

  Create an agent using the Agent Hub API.

Arguments:
  slug  Agent slug  [required]
  name  Display name  [required]

Options:
  --primary-model <str>           Primary model id.  [required]
  --system-prompt-file <path>     System prompt file.  [required]
  --description <str>
  --temperature <float range>     [default: 0.1; 0.0<=x<=2.0]
  --timeout-seconds <float range>
                                  [x>=1.0]
  --thinking-level <str>
  --verbosity-level <str>
  --active / --inactive           [default: active]
  --coding-agent / --non-coding-agent
                                  [default: non-coding-agent]
  --fallback-model <str>
  --escalation-model <str>
  --memory-config-file <path>
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
help.preview:
Usage: agents preview [OPTIONS] {slug}

  Show the effective runtime prompt/context preview for an agent.

Arguments:
  slug  Agent slug  [required]

Options:
  -m, --mode <str>     Preview mode: chat, review  [default: chat]
  -P, --project <str>  Optional project scope
  --phase <str>        Optional phase/event hint
  --input <str>        Optional task input placeholder
  --json               Print raw JSON response
  --full-context-only  Print only the effective full context
  --show-content       Print full section bodies plus full context.
  --help               Show this message and exit.

Usage: agents credentials refs [OPTIONS]

  List identity metadata only; presence does not establish validity.

Options:

  --help          Show this message and exit.
help.credentials run:
Usage: agents credentials run [OPTIONS] {command}...

  Launch one trusted local adapter with selected fields; suppress its output.

  Read JSON through EOF from the descriptor in AGENT_HUB_LAB_CREDENTIAL_FD:
  {schema_version: 1, target: TARGET, credentials: [{reference: REF, values:
  FIELDS}]}. Only PATH and the descriptor number reach the child's
  environment. Close the descriptor after reading. A trusted login adapter may
  drive an isolated browser; an API token does not establish its browser
  session. Never use a shell, model harness or general browser executable as
  the recipient.

Arguments:
  command...  Absolute trusted child executable and nonsecret arguments
              [required]

Options:
  --target <str>    [required]
  --request <path>  [required]
  --help            Show this message and exit.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  list            Every registered host, including revoked ones.
  add             Register a host, or re-admit a revoked one with a fresh...
  revoke          Invalidate the host's token and drop its grants.
  grant
  deny
  tools           Map rows with stored/expiry state.
  tool-add
  tool-remove
  credential-set  Save (or replace) the value granted hosts fetch for...
help.hosts list:
Usage: agents hosts list [OPTIONS]

  Every registered host, including revoked ones.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.hosts add:
Usage: agents hosts add [OPTIONS] {name}

  Register a host, or re-admit a revoked one with a fresh token and no grants.

  Hand the file to the host with `ssh HOST agent-hub install --token-stdin <
  FILE`, then delete it.

Arguments:
  name  Host name, e.g. the ssh alias  [required]

Options:
  --token-out <path>  New file to receive the token (created 0600)  [required]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
help.hosts revoke:
Usage: agents hosts revoke [OPTIONS] {name}

  Invalidate the host's token and drop its grants.

Arguments:
  name  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.hosts grant:
Usage: agents hosts grant [OPTIONS] {name} {tool}

Arguments:
  name  [required]
  tool  Tether tool slug  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.hosts deny:
Usage: agents hosts deny [OPTIONS] {name} {tool}

Arguments:
  name  [required]
  tool  Tether tool slug  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.hosts tools:
Usage: agents hosts tools [OPTIONS]

  Map rows with stored/expiry state.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.hosts tool-add:
Usage: agents hosts tool-add [OPTIONS]

Options:
  --tool <str>              Tether tool slug  [required]
  --name <str>              [required]
  --command <str>           Executable the host shim stands in for  [required]
  --config-dir <str>        The tool's real config dir, ~/-relative
                            [required]
  --env-var <str>
  --auth-file <str>         Path under the config dir
  --rotates / --no-rotates  [default: no-rotates]
  --description <str>
  --help                    Show this message and exit.
help.hosts tool-remove:
Usage: agents hosts tool-remove [OPTIONS] {tool} {name}

Arguments:
  tool  [required]
  name  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.hosts credential-set:
Usage: agents hosts credential-set [OPTIONS] {tool} {name}

  Save (or replace) the value granted hosts fetch for TOOL/NAME. Hosts push
  theirs with `agent-hub credential push`.

Arguments:
  tool  [required]
  name  [required]

Options:
  --input <str>       Your private (0600) file, or - for piped stdin
                      [required]
  --expires-at <str>  ISO time with timezone
  --help              Show this message and exit.

usage.when: inspect one agent's canonical routing, fallbacks, escalation, timeout, and memory summary
inspect compact agent routing/config version history without raw DB queries
inspect recent agent sessions and complete requests without raw DB queries
inspect agent prompt/context size; verify injection

usage.cmd: st agents credentials enroll --target TARGET --actor ACTOR --kind synthetic|temporary --input FILE|- [--expires-at ISO]
usage.when: enroll approved lab fields; agents may enroll synthetic actors under existing local lab authority; private file or piped stdin only

usage.cmd: st agents credentials refresh --target TARGET --actor ACTOR --input FILE|- [--expires-at ISO]
usage.when: replace a known synthetic bundle under existing lab authority after local credential or session renewal; never pass values in arguments
list lab target/actor references (all targets without --target) without reading encrypted values

usage.cmd: st agents credentials run --target TARGET --request FILE -- /absolute/trusted-child [ARGS]
usage.when: trusted local launcher supplies selected lab fields in an inherited descriptor; API tokens do not establish browser sessions
list remote hosts, their granted tools and when each last fetched

usage.cmd: st agents hosts add NAME --token-out FILE
usage.when: register a remote host; its bearer token is written once to a new 0600 file, never printed
stop every future credential fetch by a host

usage.cmd: st agents hosts grant NAME TOOL
usage.when: let a host fetch a tool's served credentials at launch

usage.cmd: st agents hosts deny NAME TOOL
usage.when: remove a host's grant for a tool
show the per-tool credential map and whether Agent Hub holds each served value (never the values)

usage.cmd: st agents hosts tool-add --tool SLUG --name NAME --command CMD --config-dir ~/DIR (--env-var VAR | --auth-file FILE) [--rotates]
usage.when: add a credential row to the per-tool map

usage.cmd: st agents hosts tool-remove TOOL NAME
usage.when: remove a map row and any value stored for it

usage.cmd: st agents hosts credential-set TOOL NAME --input FILE|- [--expires-at ISO]
usage.when: store a non-rotating tool credential created on the workstation; private file or piped stdin only, never argv
